dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible across the dorsal and lateral regions. These structures feature dark, irregular outer perimeters that transition through a soft gradient to significantly lighter, speckled internal centers, particularly along the mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity light-colored pixel blobs are dense along the lower lateral flank and towards the anterior neck region. These lack internal gradient structures and appear as solid, irregular patches against the darker background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationships include an irregular quadrilateral formed by the centroids of four prominent mid-dorsal annuli, and a series of acute triangular clusters formed by high-intensity blobs along the ventral-lateral margin.
